Monthly adjustments to depression storage are now applied only to the pervious area of subcatchments instead of to both pervious and impervious areas.
The Status Report now includes a grouped frequency table of the variable routing time steps used during a simulation.
An error in the average summary statistics reported for projects with a reporting start date later than the simulation start date was fixed.
